title: Una década perdida
goal: Read why the 1980s became known as Latin America's "lost decade" -- near-zero per capita growth, a debt that kept growing anyway, and the 1989 Brady Plan that finally marked its formal end.

items: State what happened to per capita income across the 1980s.
Explain why the decade earned the "lost decade" label.
Explain why the debt kept growing despite the crisis.
Describe what Nicholas Brady proposed in 1989.
Use a lo largo de to span an entire period of time.
